target_profile.system_boundary: The github.com/hashicorp/raft library, including its protocol coordination, FSM scheduling, and built-in storage and transport implementations. Application FSM semantics and separately maintained storage implementations are outside the concrete supplied implementation, while their library interfaces remain in scope.
protocol_contexts: Candidate, follower, and leader states with election terms.
Leader-local commitment tracking over voter ServerIDs and log indexes.
Snapshot versions, snapshot log index and term, and configuration index.
Ordinary elections, optional pre-vote, and leadership-transfer election entry.
external_interfaces: Apply, ApplyLog, Barrier, VerifyLeader, and configuration query APIs.
Transport RPCs, optional WithPreVote, and optional heartbeat fast-pass handler.
FSM, BatchingFSM, FSMSnapshot, and optional ConfigurationStore callbacks.
Log-store StoreLogs, FirstIndex, LastIndex, and DeleteRange calls.
Snapshot-store Create and Open, and snapshot-sink Close and Cancel.
ownership: runCandidate executes candidate event handling on the main protocol loop.
commitment serializes its voter-match map and commit index with a mutex.
runFSM owns local application/snapshot position variables and invokes application callbacks.
takeSnapshot requests FSM capture and obtains configuration state through futures.
installSnapshot coordinates streaming, sink finalization, FSM restore acknowledgement, and protocol metadata updates.
FileSnapshotSink owns file finalization and publication operations.
selection_injection: runFSM selects batching and configuration-storage behavior by type assertion against the supplied FSM.
installSnapshot selects full log removal versus bounded compaction using MonotonicLogStore and IsMonotonic.
Transport permits either a heartbeat callback fast path or delivery through Consumer; the activated transport is unknown.
A built-in FileSnapshotSink implementation is present and remains in scope; constructor selection and the currently selected snapshot store are unread.
README identifies separately maintained MDB and Bbolt storage adapters; it does not establish which adapter is selected.
Constructor assembly, adapter ownership, and startup selection require api.go source.
variants: ConfigurationStore present versus absent in the single-entry FSM path.
Pre-vote enabled versus disabled, with leadership transfer bypassing pre-vote.
Configuration log encoding below protocol version 2 versus version 2 or later.
Snapshot version 0 peer decoding versus newer configuration decoding.
Monotonic log-store cleanup versus trailing-log compaction.
File snapshot synchronization enabled versus noSync, with parent-directory synchronization skipped on Windows.
unknowns: Actual constructor arguments, deployment configuration, and selected storage and transport variants.
Startup reconstruction of terms, votes, snapshots, log indexes, and configurations.
Persistence and partial-error semantics of selected log and stable stores.
Replication success correlation, pipeline behavior, and heartbeat-derived evidence consumers.
Precise FSM event-loop dispatch after line 240 and future synchronization semantics.
No supplied execution observations establish calibration or protocol correctness.

activities.purpose: Admit log work and advance leader-local decisions from reported replication progress.
activities.realization_summary: Local dispatch assigns indexes and terms, calls StoreLogs, and reports local progress. commitment calculates a voter order statistic and advances only at or above startIndex. Remote progress establishment and the commit-index consumer remain unread.
unknowns: Remote match producers and main-loop commit processing

unknowns: Vote producers, term persistence, role-setter effects, and leader lease handling

activities.purpose: Restore replica state and resume protocol participation.
activities.realization_summary: Remote snapshot installation waits for an FSM restore future before updating snapshot, application, and configuration metadata. Startup recovery and incremental catch-up are deferred.
unknowns: Startup recovery, append-based catch-up, and behavior after partial application restore failure

activities.purpose: Construct, expose, and consume membership configurations.
activities.realization_summary: appendConfigurationEntry computes a proposed configuration, dispatches its log, updates latest configuration, replaces commitment voters, and adjusts replication. Snapshot installation replaces latest and committed configuration metadata.
unknowns: Change admission serialization, nextConfiguration validation, and committed-configuration advancement

activities.purpose: Schedule decided work and invoke application callbacks with corresponding completion results.
activities.realization_summary: runFSM defines single and batched application handlers, restore, and snapshot capture. Application callback implementation is external, but filtering, ordering, positions, and future completion are library responsibilities.
unknowns: Complete event-loop dispatch and processLogs producer behavior

activities.purpose: Store logs and create, publish, compact, and recover snapshot evidence.
activities.realization_summary: Normal log dispatch calls StoreLogs. Snapshot creation persists an FSM capture, closes the sink, updates snapshot metadata, and compacts logs. FileSnapshotSink separately finalizes files, publishes a directory, and reaps older snapshots.
unknowns: Store contracts, snapshot opening and selection, metadata writing, retention, and restart behavior

activities.purpose: Expose admission, completion, leadership verification, and barrier semantics to callers.
activities.realization_summary: ApplyLog and Barrier return futures after enqueueing or immediate admission errors. FSM handlers complete associated futures after callback processing. VerifyLeader only enqueues a request in the supplied API code.
variants: Leadership loss and restore errors described by API comments
unknowns: Future implementation, verification completion, retry identity, and caller deduplication responsibilities
